rationale: Hand-curated appellation gazetteer for ETL backfill. Source: official AOC/DOC/DOCG/DOCa/AVA registries cross-referenced with Wikidata. Entries are FACTS not heuristics. When in doubt, omit. Used by tools/wikidata-backfill/appellation-matcher.ts to resolve the `appellation` field for silver records whose Vivino payload lacked one. Coverage targets the top wine regions by global trade volume (Bordeaux, Burgundy, Tuscany, Piedmont, Rioja, Napa, Barossa, etc.) and the top sub-regions for the long-tail.
